# Employee Management System

## Project
Build an Employee Management System using:
- ASP.NET Core
- Razor Pages
- ASP.NET Core Web API
- Entity Framework Core

## Employee
Employee has:
- Id
- Name
- Department
- Salary
- Email

## Architecture
Use:
- Models for data models
- Data for DbContext
- Controllers for Web API
- Pages for Razor Pages UI
- Services only when needed

## Rules
- Use C# and ASP.NET Core.
- Use Entity Framework Core for database access.
- Use async and await for database operations.
- Use dependency injection.
- Use proper HTTP status codes.
- Validate user input.
- Keep the code simple and beginner-friendly.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Do not create unnecessary files.
- Tell me which files will be changed before making major changes.
- Explain important code because I am learning.

## Development Approach
Build the project step by step.

Do not build the entire application at once.

For each step:
1. Explain what we are doing.
2. Tell me which file will be changed.
3. Provide the code.
4. Explain the important parts.
5. Tell me how to test it.
6. Wait for the next step before making major changes.
